content: Provision local MySQL (dev) + install mysql2; set MYSQL_* env in api/.env
Build db.js: MySQL pool + Mongo-compatible collection shim (findOne/find/insert/update/delete/count, $set/$addToSet/$pull/$in/$ne/$or/$regex) + table init
Rewrite data layer in index.js to use db.js; admin auth via ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD
Migrate preview MongoDB content -> MySQL (projects, updates, posts, team, faqs, site_content, leads, visits, users, uploads)
Test backend end-to-end on MySQL (public + admin + favorites + reminders)
mysqldump to importable .sql for Hostinger + update DEPLOY docs/.env.example with MYSQL_* vars
Frontend admin login: username field; verify full app via screenshots
